options.text: We consolidated twelve dashboards into three.
We consolidated the file to the archive folder.
We consolidated a new engineer onto the team.
We consolidated the meeting until next Tuesday.

explanation: consolidate 表示把多個東西合併成更少、更集中的整體，數量從十二減為三正是典型用法。

distractorExplanations.b: 搬移檔案要用 move，consolidate 沒有「移到某處」的意思。
distractorExplanations.c: 加入新成員要用 add 或 onboard，consolidate 不用於人員加入。
distractorExplanations.d: 延後會議要用 postpone 或 push back。

options.text: The requirement is ambiguous: it could mean either ascending or descending order.
I am ambiguous about whether to accept the offer.
The server was ambiguous and returned a 500 error.
She spoke ambiguous and nobody could hear her.

explanation: ambiguous 描述「一段訊息可以有兩種以上合理解讀」，選項 A 正好舉出了兩種解讀。

distractorExplanations.b: 人感到猶豫不決要用 uncertain 或 undecided，ambiguous 只形容訊息本身。
distractorExplanations.c: 伺服器故障不是「有歧義」，應該說 unreliable 或直接描述錯誤。
distractorExplanations.d: 此處需要副詞，且「聽不清楚」是音量問題，與歧義無關。

options.text: Retries with exponential backoff mitigate the impact of transient network errors.
The patch mitigated the bug completely and it never occurred again.
We mitigated the new feature to production last Friday.
The team mitigated a substantial improvement in throughput.

explanation: mitigate 表示「減輕負面影響但未根除」，重試機制無法阻止網路錯誤發生，只能降低衝擊。

distractorExplanations.b: mitigate 本身就含有「沒有完全解決」的意思，與 completely 矛盾；應該用 fixed 或 eliminated。
distractorExplanations.c: 部署功能要用 shipped、released 或 deployed。
distractorExplanations.d: mitigate 的受詞必須是負面的東西，improvement 是正面成果。

options.text: Being pragmatic does not preclude being rigorous.
He precluded the meeting because he was ill.
She precluded her colleague on the design document.
The team precluded the release notes before shipping.

explanation: A does not preclude B 是最實用的句型，用來澄清「兩者可以並存」。

distractorExplanations.b: 取消會議要用 cancelled；preclude 是「事先斷絕某種可能性」，不是取消已排定的活動。
distractorExplanations.c: 與同事合作要用 collaborated with。
distractorExplanations.d: 撰寫發行說明要用 wrote 或 prepared。

prompt: Which sentence uses "leverage" in its standard business sense?

options.text: Being the only supplier gave them considerable leverage in the negotiation.
He used a leverage to open the crate.
She has a lot of leverages over the schedule.
They leveraged that the deadline should move.

explanation: 作名詞時 leverage 指「談判籌碼」，是不可數名詞，have/give leverage in a negotiation 是標準用法。

distractorExplanations.b: 撬開箱子的工具是 lever（槓桿），不是 leverage。
distractorExplanations.c: leverage 作此義時不可數，不能加 s。
distractorExplanations.d: leverage 是及物動詞，後面接名詞受詞，不能接 that 子句。

options.text: I could sense the problem but struggled to articulate it.
I articulated the report to my manager by email.
The joint articulates the two pipes into one.
She articulated the meeting to Thursday.

explanation: articulate 指「把腦中模糊的想法轉換成清楚的語言」，struggle to articulate 是極常見的搭配。

distractorExplanations.b: 寄送報告要用 sent；articulate 的受詞是想法，不是文件。
distractorExplanations.c: 連接管線要用 connect 或 join。
distractorExplanations.d: 改期要用 moved 或 rescheduled。

options.text: Each team documented its respective part of the migration.
Please send the file to the respective person.
He was very respective to the senior engineers.
The respective of the two options is clear.

explanation: respective 需要多個主體（Each team 隱含多個團隊），並將它們與各自對應的事物配對。

distractorExplanations.b: 只有單一對象時不能用 respective，應該用 appropriate 或 relevant。
distractorExplanations.c: 形容態度恭敬要用 respectful。
distractorExplanations.d: respective 是形容詞，不能當名詞使用。

options.text: Compression cost is negligible compared with network latency.
The reviewer was negligible and missed the security flaw.
We should negligible this optimization for now.
Her contribution was negligible in size but she led the project.

explanation: negligible 形容「小到在決策時可以直接忽略」，與 compared with 的比較結構完全吻合。

distractorExplanations.b: 形容人疏忽失職要用 negligent。
distractorExplanations.c: negligible 是形容詞，不能當動詞用；此處應該用 skip 或 deprioritize。
distractorExplanations.d: 句子自相矛盾：主導專案的貢獻不可能是微不足道的。

options.text: Newcomers often conflate authentication with authorization.
We conflated the three repositories into a monorepo.
She conflated the balloon before the party.
The evidence conflates his account of the incident.

explanation: conflate 指「錯誤地把兩個應該分開的概念混為一談」，身分驗證與授權正是最經典的例子。

distractorExplanations.b: 刻意且正面的整合要用 consolidated 或 merged，conflate 永遠帶有批評意味。
distractorExplanations.c: 把氣球充氣是 inflate，拼字相近但意思完全不同。
distractorExplanations.d: 證據支持說法要用 corroborates。

options.text: The first request populates the cache; subsequent requests are served from memory.
The release was subsequent, so we waited.
We subsequent the migration to next month.
This bug is subsequent than the previous one.

explanation: subsequent 是形容詞，放在名詞前表示「隨後的」，此處對比第一次與後續的請求。

distractorExplanations.b: subsequent 幾乎只用在名詞前面，不用在 be 動詞之後單獨使用。
distractorExplanations.c: subsequent 不是動詞；延後要用 postponed。
distractorExplanations.d: subsequent 沒有比較級形式，不能搭配 than。

options.text: Every change to the payment code receives extra scrutiny in review.
We did a scrutiny of the code before merging.
He scrutiny the logs for two hours.
The scrutinies revealed three separate bugs.

explanation: scrutiny 是不可數名詞，可以被 extra、close、careful 等形容詞修飾。

distractorExplanations.b: scrutiny 不可數，不能說 a scrutiny；應該說 We scrutinized the code。
distractorExplanations.c: 此處需要動詞，正確形式是 scrutinized。
distractorExplanations.d: scrutiny 不可數，沒有複數形 scrutinies。

prompt: In which sentence is "ostensibly" used most appropriately?

options.text: The change was ostensibly about performance, though most of us suspected otherwise.
The test passed ostensibly, and we confirmed it three times.
She was ostensibly the most qualified, and everyone agreed.
The build is ostensibly green, so we can ship with confidence.

explanation: ostensibly 帶有「表面說法可能不是實情」的懷疑語氣，though most of us suspected otherwise 正好提供了這個轉折。

distractorExplanations.b: 已經確認三次就沒有懷疑餘地，應該直接說 The test passed。
distractorExplanations.c: everyone agreed 表示沒有異議，與 ostensibly 的懷疑語氣衝突。
distractorExplanations.d: 若真的有信心就不該用 ostensibly，這個字反而會讓讀者以為建置狀態有問題。

options.text: Ambiguity is inherent to natural language and cannot be engineered away.
She inherent a large sum from her aunt.
The bug was inherent last Tuesday during the deploy.
We added an inherent feature to the dashboard.

explanation: inherent 表示「本質上就存在、無法移除」，後半句 cannot be engineered away 正好呼應。

distractorExplanations.b: 繼承遺產是動詞 inherit，拼字相近但詞性與意思都不同。
distractorExplanations.c: inherent 描述恆常的本質，不能用來描述某個特定時間發生的事件。
distractorExplanations.d: 新加上去的功能依定義就不是「與生俱來」的，語意矛盾。

prompt: Which sentence uses "validate" in its standard technical sense?

options.text: The endpoint validates the request body against a schema before processing it.
The endpoint validates the request to the database for storage.
We validated the server into three availability zones.
The team validated the meeting notes to everyone.

explanation: validate 指「對照標準或規則檢查」，validate X against a schema 是標準搭配。

distractorExplanations.b: 把資料存進資料庫要用 writes 或 persists。
distractorExplanations.c: 把伺服器分散部署要用 distributed 或 deployed across。
distractorExplanations.d: 分送會議記錄要用 circulated 或 shared。
